By default this endpoint joins the schedule with the shared zones that use it. These operations can be expensive. This data is not needed for most uses. Use an `options` value of `withoutZoneUsers,withoutZoneGroups` where possible for better performance. The caller can also specify one option without the other option if required. The syntax is as such: `/orgs/{orgId}/schedules/{scheduleId}?options=withoutZoneUsers,withoutZoneGroups`.
